ingredientSections.heading: Sauce
items: 6 Asparagus Spears, cut into 6 pieces each
½ Fennel Bulb, cored and thinly sliced

methodSections.heading: Gnocchi
steps: Clean and then bake the potatoes, whole and skin on, at 230°C (450°F) until done. A knife should pass into the potato without resistance.
Cut in half lengthwise whilst hot to remove steam.
Mix all dry ingredients in a bowl.
With a potato ricer (or fine grater), rice the potatoes into the dry ingredients and mix with finger tips to coat the potato in flour.
Add the egg yolk and gently kneed the mixture. Don't over kneed, the potatoes may become gluey.
Cut dough into quarters and roll out into sausages with your hands and cut into 2-3cm (1in) pieces.
Blanch the gnocchi in boiling water. As they begin to float scoop them out with a slotted spoon. Allow to cool on an oiled parchment lined tray.

methodSections.heading: Sauce
steps: In a large frying pan heat a shallow frying portion of canola oil until just below smoking point.
Add the gnocchi and fry until golden brown on one side.
Flip the pan to turn the gnocchi and add the shallots, garlic, fennel, and asparagus, and fry until the vegetables start to soften.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink.
Deglaze with the wine and reduce by half.
Add the cream and butter and season with salt.
Reduce until cream lightly coats the gnocchi and shrimp.
Add lemon juice and zest and toss.
